title: stochastic-settling
description: A continuous-valued settling whose value category is the stochastic semiring ([0,1], multiplication-as-tensor, convex-combination-as-sum); cells hold transition probabilities and the closure step is one Markov advance, settling to the stationary distribution. Generated by specializing continuous-valued settling to probability values.

stateSpace.description: the finite or countable state space S over which cells (s,o) range

stochastic.description: P : S x S -> [0,1] with sum_o P(s,o) = 1 for each s; v_k(s,o) = P^k(s,o) is the k-step transition probability

valueCategory.description: V = ([0,1], tensor = multiplication along sequential paths, sum = convex combination over alternative paths) - a Markov-category-enriched value category, not a Lawvere quantale

closureOperator.description: T_stoch(v)(s,o) = sum_z v(s,z) * P(z,o); matrix multiplication in V

closureRegime.description: Scott-continuous-V at omega: stationary distribution is the omega-supremum (Cesaro-averaged if periodic), realized only in the limit (geometric convergence, no finite step exact)
